import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
import os
import re

# Load data
train = pd.read_csv("./input/en_train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./input/en_test_2.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/en_sample_submission_2.csv")

# Precompute global most common
global_after_counter = Counter(train["after"])
global_most_common = global_after_counter.most_common(1)[0][0]

# Precompute direct before->after mapping (most common)
before_to_after = {}
for before, group in train.groupby("before"):
    before_to_after[before] = group["after"].value_counts().idxmax()


# Generate character n-grams (3-grams) for a token
def get_char_ngrams(token, n=3):
    if pd.isna(token) or token == "":
        return []
    token = str(token)
    token = "^" + token + "$"
    return [token[i : i + n] for i in range(len(token) - n + 1)]


# Build n-gram to after mapping
ngram_after_counter = defaultdict(Counter)
for _, row in train.iterrows():
    before = row["before"]
    after = row["after"]
    if pd.isna(before):
        continue
    ngrams = get_char_ngrams(before)
    for ng in ngrams:
        ngram_after_counter[ng][after] += 1

# Convert to most common ngram->after mapping
ngram_to_after = {}
for ng, counter in ngram_after_counter.items():
    ngram_to_after[ng] = counter.most_common(1)[0][0]

# Group train by sentence_id to reconstruct sentences for context
train_sentences = (
    train.groupby("sentence_id")
    .apply(
        lambda df: list(
            zip(df["token_id"].values, df["before"].values, df["after"].values)
        )
    )
    .to_dict()
)

# Build precomputed context maps with position info
left_context_map = {}
for sentence_id, tokens in train_sentences.items():
    n = len(tokens)
    for i in range(n):
        _, curr_before, curr_after = tokens[i]
        if i > 0:
            _, prev_before, _ = tokens[i - 1]
            is_first = "first" if i == 1 else "not_first"
            key = (prev_before, curr_before, is_first)
            if key not in left_context_map:
                left_context_map[key] = Counter()
            left_context_map[key][curr_after] += 1

left_context_map = {k: v.most_common(1)[0][0] for k, v in left_context_map.items() if v}

right_context_map = {}
for sentence_id, tokens in train_sentences.items():
    n = len(tokens)
    for i in range(n):
        _, curr_before, curr_after = tokens[i]
        if i < n - 1:
            _, next_before, _ = tokens[i + 1]
            is_last = "last" if i == n - 2 else "not_last"
            key = (curr_before, next_before, is_last)
            if key not in right_context_map:
                right_context_map[key] = Counter()
            right_context_map[key][curr_after] += 1

right_context_map = {
    k: v.most_common(1)[0][0] for k, v in right_context_map.items() if v
}

# For validation: hold out 10% of sentences
np.random.seed(42)
sentence_ids = list(train_sentences.keys())
np.random.shuffle(sentence_ids)
val_size = int(0.1 * len(sentence_ids))
val_sentence_ids = set(sentence_ids[:val_size])

# Extract validation set with context and position features
val_rows = []
for sid in val_sentence_ids:
    tokens = train_sentences[sid]
    n = len(tokens)
    for i in range(len(tokens)):
        token_id, curr_before, curr_after = tokens[i]
        prev_before = tokens[i - 1][1] if i > 0 else "<SOS>"
        next_before = tokens[i + 1][1] if i < len(tokens) - 1 else "<EOS>"
        is_first = "first" if i == 1 else "not_first"
        is_last = "last" if i == n - 2 else "not_last"

        val_rows.append(
            {
                "sentence_id": sid,
                "token_id": token_id,
                "before": curr_before,
                "after": curr_after,
                "prev_before": prev_before,
                "next_before": next_before,
                "is_first": is_first,
                "is_last": is_last,
            }
        )

val_df = pd.DataFrame(val_rows)


def predict_batch(before, prev_before, next_before, is_first, is_last):
    preds = []
    for b, pb, nb, f, l in zip(before, prev_before, next_before, is_first, is_last):
        # Try left context with position
        val = left_context_map.get((pb, b, f), None)
        if val is not None:
            preds.append(val)
            continue
        # Try right context with position
        val = right_context_map.get((b, nb, l), None)
        if val is not None:
            preds.append(val)
            continue
        # Try direct before mapping
        val = before_to_after.get(b, None)
        if val is not None:
            preds.append(val)
            continue
        # Try ngram-based fallback
        if pd.notna(b):
            ngrams = get_char_ngrams(b)
            ngram_preds = []
            for ng in ngrams:
                if ng in ngram_to_after:
                    ngram_preds.append(ngram_to_after[ng])
            if ngram_preds:
                preds.append(Counter(ngram_preds).most_common(1)[0][0])
                continue
        # Fallback
        preds.append(global_most_common)
    return preds


# Predict on validation set
val_df["pred"] = predict_batch(
    val_df["before"].values,
    val_df["prev_before"].values,
    val_df["next_before"].values,
    val_df["is_first"].values,
    val_df["is_last"].values,
)
accuracy = (val_df["after"] == val_df["pred"]).mean()
print(f"Validation accuracy: {accuracy:.6f}")

# Prepare test set for prediction
test_sentences = (
    test.groupby("sentence_id")
    .apply(lambda df: list(zip(df["token_id"].values, df["before"].values)))
    .to_dict()
)

# Precompute context for all test tokens with position features
test_rows = []
for sid, tokens in test_sentences.items():
    n = len(tokens)
    for i in range(len(tokens)):
        token_id, curr_before = tokens[i]
        prev_before = tokens[i - 1][1] if i > 0 else "<SOS>"
        next_before = tokens[i + 1][1] if i < len(tokens) - 1 else "<EOS>"
        is_first = "first" if i == 1 else "not_first"
        is_last = "last" if i == n - 2 else "not_last"

        test_rows.append(
            {
                "id": f"{sid}_{token_id}",
                "before": curr_before,
                "prev_before": prev_before,
                "next_before": next_before,
                "is_first": is_first,
                "is_last": is_last,
            }
        )

test_context_df = pd.DataFrame(test_rows)

# Predict on test set
test_context_df["after"] = predict_batch(
    test_context_df["before"].values,
    test_context_df["prev_before"].values,
    test_context_df["next_before"].values,
    test_context_df["is_first"].values,
    test_context_df["is_last"].values,
)

# Build submission
submission = sample_sub[["id"]].copy()
id_to_pred = dict(zip(test_context_df["id"], test_context_df["after"]))
submission["after"] = submission["id"].map(id_to_pred)
submission["after"] = submission["after"].fillna(global_most_common)
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
